purpose: Pins the supported Claude Code baseline wire contract that RLY depends on (#24). The canary fails with a typed fixture reason when a client version stops producing/consuming one of these behaviors.

attribution.note: Gateway requests carry these headers for session/subagent attribution; they are parsed from headers only, never from prompt/body content, and carry no authorization meaning.

modelDiscovery.note: Discovery currently filters returned model ids to those beginning with claude/anthropic and caches results between startups; RLY projection ids use the Claude-compatible claude-rly- namespace.

aliases.note: Subagents support model aliases on sufficiently new clients; fable is a portable tier resolved contextually by RLY, never a hardcoded global model. Exact physical model ids are never reinterpreted as tiers.

effort.note: Subagent/session effort is an optional documented additive field (top-level or inside thinking). When absent no source effort is assumed; the canonical ReasoningRequest keeps sourceEffort fidelity.

additiveFields.note: Unknown additive beta/metadata fields are deliberately preserved/ignored by RLY, never assumed.

framing.note: Print-mode launches add --no-session-persistence so a gateway-scoped Claude run never writes session state.
